#### Freddy AI by Freshworks
- **Comparison to feature:** Freddy AI offers support across multiple communication channels but lacks details on real-time response metrics.
- **Pricing:** Freddy AI Copilot starts at $29/agent/month when billed annually. [Source: Freshworks Pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing/)
- **Accuracy:** Vendor states Freddy deflects up to 86% of inquiries, which is similar to Zendesk's reported accuracy rates. [Source: Freshworks Live Chat Pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/live-chat-software/pricing/)
- **Latency:** Vendor describes proactive assistance but gives no specific latency figures. [Source: Freshworks Pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing/)
